title: Grades of the Jumbo Figure on a Certificate of Deposit Term
content:
On the Certificates of Deposit line the jumbo figure earned by a new term is graded, and a certificate that falls a little short of the tier's jumbo threshold may still reach a grade where the owner's deposit relationship makes up the difference.

## 1. The grades

The jumbo figure is graded: a certificate whose principal carried into the new term is at least the tier's jumbo threshold and whose owner holds an active savings or money market account earns the tier's jumbo bonus points in full; a certificate whose principal carried into the new term is below the tier's jumbo threshold but at least nine tenths of it, and which together with the balance of the owner's active savings or money market account reaches the tier's jumbo threshold, earns half the tier's jumbo bonus points; every other certificate earns nothing.

## 2. The figures the grades turn on

The jumbo threshold on every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line is 100000.00 USD, and nine tenths of that figure is 90000.00 USD. The account whose balance may be brought in is an active account of the bank's Savings & Money Market Accounts line, held by the same owner.

## 3. Condition, judgement and result

| Principal carried into the new term | Owner's active savings or money market account | Principal plus that balance | Jumbo figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 100000.00 USD or more | held | not asked | the tier's jumbo bonus points in full |
| 100000.00 USD or more | none held | not asked | nothing |
| at least 90000.00 but below 100000.00 USD | held | reaches 100000.00 USD | half the tier's jumbo bonus points |
| at least 90000.00 but below 100000.00 USD | held, or none held | falls short of 100000.00 USD | nothing |
| below 90000.00 USD | any | any | nothing |

## 4. Boundary readings

A certificate carrying exactly 100000.00 USD into the new term whose owner holds an active savings account earns the points in full, the threshold being a floor rather than a figure to be exceeded.

A certificate carrying exactly 90000.00 USD, whose owner holds an active money market account of 10000.00 USD, reaches exactly 100000.00 USD between them and so earns half the points. Were the deposit balance 9000.00 USD, the pair would come to 99000.00 USD, the threshold would not be reached, and the figure earned would be nothing.

A certificate carrying 89000.00 USD is below nine tenths of the threshold, and no deposit balance can lift it into a grade.

## 5. The half figure

Where the middle grade is met the figure is half the points the tier publishes for the jumbo bonus. On a tier publishing 0.10 points that is 0.05 points; the halving falls on the bonus points, never on the threshold.
